newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed in sideways market.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed in sideways market.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed on Tuesday with the one-week rising while the rest were either steady or lower, traders said.
The slightly higher one-week rate reflected the demand for pesos as banks borrowed through PHIBOR to lend to the overnight market, dealers said.
The PHIBOR rates for the rest of the maturities, however, did not rise since banks expect the tight liquidity situation to correct soon, they said.
"This is just a temporary tightness. In a week, it could come down," a dealer said.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
